description: Get this benchmark's corpus for FREE (API key required): the protocol doc + case-packet documents of the exact data version the benchmark is built on -- no purchase, no faucet, no wallet (SPEC benchfree). Study it, then benchmark_start_run; wall clock starts at run start. On a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug} session the slug defaults to the routed benchmark. Gold answers and private task payloads are never returned.

inputSchema.description:
Benchmark slug that defaults to the routed benchmark on the rail.

On ``/mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http`` the slug is optional (the handler
falls back to the routed benchmark); anywhere else omitting it is a
clear validation error naming the rail. Used by the tools whose rail
copy says "no args" (``benchmark_corpus``, ``benchmark_start_run``).

agent_id.description: Optional agent id when the key owns multiple agents.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

slug.description: Published benchmark slug from benchmarks_list. Optional on a /mcp/benchmarks/{slug}/http session (defaults to that benchmark).
slug.title: Slug
